lists.text: Purpose test: stated goal vs pattern; whose buffers a plan protects vs drains reveals the real goal Metrology: traceability + stated uncertainty on every reading Hoarding as a strategy: test against population genetics (minimum viable population, diversity loss, inbreeding depression), closed-system maintenance, skill and supply-chain dependence Hoarding bottleneck evidence split: genetic (weak except isolated dynasties) / microbiome (stronger: affluent, industrialized biomes less diverse) / epigenetic (thin, contested) Decision rule under uncertainty: when evidence is thin or contested and the outcome is irreversible, don't bet on it; keep diversity (genetic, biome, skills) as the buffer that preserves options Knowledge horizon: current biology is a provisional snapshot (e.g. human chimerism, fetal microchimerism, widespread mosaicism found within living memory); irreversible selection by wealth or industrial value discards variation before its function is known = cutting an unseen buffer

Metrology: traceability + stated uncertainty on every reading

Decision rule under uncertainty: when evidence is thin or contested and the outcome is irreversible, don't bet on it; keep diversity (genetic, biome, skills) as the buffer that preserves options
